corpus_note: Demo corpus written for this Sparky Next environment. It is NOT any real retailer's policy and must not be quoted as such.

sections.text: Most items can be returned within 90 days of purchase with a receipt or order number. Electronics have a 30 day return window. Return an item in store or start a return online from your order history.
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Card refunds usually post within 3 to 5 business days; SNAP EBT refunds return to the EBT card.
Opened perishable groceries, gift cards and prescription items cannot be returned. Damaged or wrong grocery items can be refunded without returning them.

La mayoría de los productos se pueden devolver dentro de 90 días con recibo o número de pedido. Los electrónicos tienen 30 días. Puede devolver un producto en la tienda o iniciar la devolución en línea desde su historial de pedidos.
El reembolso se hace al método de pago original, normalmente en 3 a 5 días hábiles.
Choose pickup at checkout and select a store. When the order is ready you get a notification; park in a pickup spot and check in with the app. Pickup is free on orders over $35.
Small orders are usually ready in about 1 hour and larger orders in 2 to 4 hours, depending on store stock. Orders are held for 3 days.

Elija recoger en tienda al pagar y seleccione una tienda. Cuando el pedido esté listo recibirá un aviso; estaciónese en un lugar de recogida y registre su llegada en la app. Es gratis en pedidos de más de $35.
Los pedidos pequeños suelen estar listos en 1 hora y los grandes en 2 a 4 horas. Los pedidos se guardan 3 días.
Delivery is available in most areas in 2 hour windows. A delivery fee from $6.95 to $9.95 applies to orders under $35; the minimum order is $35 for free delivery windows.
If nobody is home, perishable items are not left at the door and the order is refunded.
La entrega a domicilio está disponible en ventanas de 2 horas. Se cobra una tarifa de $6.95 a $9.95 en pedidos de menos de $35.
If an item is out of stock we may substitute a similar item of equal or greater size at the same price or lower. You can turn substitutions off per item before checkout.
You can reject a substitute at pickup or delivery and you will not be charged for it.
Si un producto está agotado podemos sustituirlo por uno similar al mismo precio o menor. Puede desactivar las sustituciones por producto antes de pagar.
SNAP EBT cards can be used online and in store for eligible grocery items. Enter the EBT card at checkout; eligible items are paid first from the SNAP balance.
Most food items are SNAP eligible. Not eligible: alcohol, tobacco, vitamins and supplements, hot prepared foods, and non-food items. Delivery fees cannot be paid with SNAP.
Las tarjetas SNAP EBT se pueden usar en línea y en tienda para alimentos elegibles. No son elegibles: alcohol, tabaco, vitaminas y suplementos, comidas calientes y productos que no son alimentos.
Alcohol, tobacco and nicotine products, lighters and butane, and some knives require the buyer to be at least 21 (18 for some items). A valid photo ID is checked at pickup or delivery.
If ID cannot be verified the restricted items are removed from the order and refunded.
El alcohol, tabaco y nicotina, encendedores y algunos cuchillos requieren una edad mínima de 21 años (18 para algunos productos). Se verifica una identificación con foto al recoger o entregar.
Demo stores are open 6 am to 11 pm local time every day. Pharmacy hours are shorter. Holiday hours may differ.
Las tiendas de demostración abren de 6 am a 11 pm hora local todos los días. El horario de farmacia es más corto.
Open order history to see the status of your order: placed, being prepared, ready for pickup, out for delivery, or completed. You get notifications at each step.
Abra su historial de pedidos para ver el estado: realizado, en preparación, listo para recoger, en camino o completado.
Prices can change between adding an item and checkout. The price at checkout revalidation is the price charged. If the price drops before pickup you are charged the lower price.
Demo stores do not match competitor prices.
Los precios pueden cambiar entre agregar un producto y pagar. Se cobra el precio vigente al validar el pago; si baja antes de recoger, se cobra el precio menor.
This demo stores cart, list and order data per session in a local database. It does not collect payment details and does not execute payments. Session data can be deleted by clearing the session.
Sponsored products are paid placements. They are labelled Sponsored, capped at one per eight results, and never affect the ranking of organic results.
Los productos patrocinados son ubicaciones pagadas, están etiquetados como Patrocinado y se limitan a uno por cada ocho resultados.
The storefront supports keyboard navigation, screen readers and high contrast. Pickup associates can bring orders to the car. Contact the store for help with accessibility needs.
